notable.*->retry_wait: only with terminal_reason=transient_worker_failure. An activation or terms refusal parked in a retry queue would burn attempts on work no worker can ever run.
notable.archived->*: nothing. Reviving an archived job would rewrite a closed history.
notable.claimed->completed: in the table, and unreachable. transition_job accepts no execution proof and the database refuses a completed row without one.
notable.failed->queued: legal, for an operator requeue after a fix. Nothing in this gate calls it.
notable.queued->refused: NOT legal. An outcome without a claim never happened.
notable.refused->queued: legal, and the one that matters for this campaign. When somebody finally reads the terms, 171 blocked jobs become runnable work again rather than needing to be recreated.
